content.comment_body: In [product_name] V5 I notice options for setting line colors, backgrounds, and similar display properties. I want to remove the 'green' text (parameters) so everything prints in black for better legibility and to avoid faint lettering. How can this be accomplished? Also, when printing, the blocks are too small. Although I can adjust zoom in the on-screen view, what controls the printed scale of elements in the document? Appreciate any advice.
Hello, I'm unable to help with your first question. Apologies. To make the printed blocks larger, you can increase the "zoom" setting within the "File" > "Print" menu.
